policy: One box per visible physical stack column, including the dominant visible side and top. No individual egg boxes or aggregate wall boxes. Nested empty pink column is one stack, not a verified tray quantity. Pixel coordinates are in the EXIF-oriented source image.
reviewer: assistant visual review of original 1280x960 images, not model predictions
count_status: Physical scene counts and empty-tray scope awaiting user; boxes are detector annotations only.
selection_limit: Initial fully framed detector subset only. Three near-identical views from one scene add limited independent diversity. Remaining photos are not accepted labels. All green-scene variants must remain in train if later accepted, never validation/test. Do not claim scene-count accuracy from these annotations.
